tax.text: Keating supported the Inflation Reduction Act, which funds health and climate measures partly through a minimum corporate tax and tax enforcement.
tax.quote: All of this is paid for by establishing a minimum corporate tax to ensure that the wealthiest corporations finally start to pay their fair share

wages.text: Keating voted for the Raise the Wage Act.
wages.quote: Raise the Wage Act Vote Type: Recorded Vote Status: Passed

trade.text: His campaign says he challenges Trump’s tariffs because they raise prices and harm small businesses.
trade.quote: He is challenging Trump’s tariffs, which increase prices on everyday goods and harm small businesses

debt.text: His campaign says he has fought to protect Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Additionally, he has fought to protect Social Security and Medicare, defend reproductive rights, and support veterans and military families.

housing.text: Keating said he has supported investing in affordable housing and the workforce needed to build it.
housing.quote: investing in affordable housing and the skilled workforce needed to build it

immigration.text: Keating asked the administration to halt removal of an asylum applicant until his claim was decided.
immigration.quote: demanding an immediate halt to any efforts to remove him from the United States until his asylum claim is decided.

guns.text: He supported the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act and said he supports reinstating the assault-weapons ban.
guns.quote: including requiring people under 21 to undergo enhanced background checks, closing the “boyfriend loophole,” and providing funding to address youth mental health.

cannabis.text: Keating voted for the MORE Act, which would decriminalize cannabis federally.
cannabis.quote: MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

health.text: Keating said he has supported Community Health Centers and cosponsored Medicare for All.
health.quote: supporting Community Health Centers, and cosponsoring Medicare for All.

energy.text: Keating supports renewable-energy investments, including offshore wind, and says they reduce emissions and dependence on fossil-fuel markets.
energy.quote: I will continue fighting for investments in renewable energy, including offshore wind, which lowers energy costs, creates good-paying jobs, and reduces our dependence on volatile global fossil fuel markets.

voting.text: Keating supports the Freedom to Vote Act and restoring Voting Rights Act protections.
voting.quote: I support restoring the protections of the Voting Rights Act through the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act

tax.text: He says he will fight to lower taxes and cut unnecessary regulation for small businesses.
tax.quote: He will fight to cut unnecessary red tape, lower taxes, protect local industries, and create an economy where small businesses can grow, hire, and thrive.

debt.text: He says he will protect the benefits seniors have earned, without specifying Social Security or Medicare.
debt.quote: Honor the promises made to those who served and protect the benefits seniors have earned over a lifetime.

safety.text: He says he will back local police and common-sense safety standards.
safety.quote: Tyler will back our local police, stand up for common-sense child-safety standards, and fight to keep the communities of the 9th District places where our kids can grow up secure.

energy.text: He supports an all-of-the-above energy approach and says he will work to lower energy costs.
energy.quote: Tyler backs an all-of-the-above energy approach that puts reliable, affordable power ahead of ideology — and works to drive our sky-high energy costs back down.
